name: dashboard-karyawan
description: Aplikasi absensi WFH & monitoring karyawan — React + Vite, NestJS (gateway + 2 microservice TCP), MySQL.

scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.format: npm --prefix backend run format && npx prettier --write "frontend/src/**/*.{ts,tsx,css}"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
